newsitem.title: UK: Italian Association of Air Couriers names chairman.
newsitem.headline: Italian Association of Air Couriers names chairman.

text.p: The Italian Association of International Air Couriers (AICAI) said in a statement it named Renato Carrara as chairman.
Carrara, a manager with wide experience in the air cargo industry, has been with Federal Express since 1988.
He has held various positions such as operational director, senior manager for planning and operative administration and his most recent position was general manager for Italy and Switzerland
AICAI was founded in 1988 and has among its members DHL International, Federal Express, Sky Net and United Parcels Service. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
